businessGoal: Allow visitors to view full product details.

scenarios.goal: Verify that all product information (image, name, description, price, category badge, brand badge) is displayed correctly on the product detail page.
Verify that the related products section is displayed below the main product information on the product detail page.
Verify that each related product in the related products section is clickable and navigates to its respective detail page.

manual.reason: The acceptance criteria describe visible browser behavior and user interaction.

api.reason: Product details and related products can be validated through the application's API capabilities.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria involve user interface elements displayed on the product detail page.
